**统一主线 (D131)**: Evidence generation in LLM-based DocRE is not a fixed cost — its role depends on **model capacity** (scale-dependent tax), **training paradigm** (decoupling spectrum), and **data quality** (NLI-based filtering). 本文提出 **evidence-grounded DocRE** 作为新任务范式：LLM 同时输出关系三元组和支撑证据句。核心发现是 evidence generation 的效果并非简单的有益/有害二分，而是一个由三个维度决定的 landscape：
